Collections and housekeeping polish.

### 🚀 Features
- Smart collections can be edited after you create them.
- Background jobs show their state as chips in Settings.
- Trash shows how long until each note is deleted for good.

### ✨ Improvements
- Proper brand icons in the About panel.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v0.4.6...v0.4.7](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v0.4.6...v0.4.7)
